# N3X Ventures

> N3X Ventures is an AI-powered growth marketing agency (founded 2022, 8+ years of team experience) that builds AI automation, paid ads, SEO & GEO, lead generation, websites, social media, LinkedIn marketing, content, video editing and branding for US businesses across 25+ industries. Done-for-you, month-to-month plans. Part of the N3X family of brands alongside N3X Realty (real estate) and N3X Chain (blockchain & AI engineering).

- Website: https://n3xventures.vercel.app
- Phone / WhatsApp: 404-981-1910 (+14049811910)
- Email: n3xventures@gmail.com
- Locations: Lubbock, Texas, Atlanta, Georgia, Dubai, UAE
- Book a free 30-minute strategy call: https://n3xventures.vercel.app/contact
- Sister brand for real estate agents: https://n3xrealty.vercel.app

## Guides
- [What Is GEO? How to Get Your Business Recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/what-is-generative-engine-optimization-geo): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is how you get cited by AI search. Here's what it is, how it differs from SEO, and a practical checklist to start today.
- [Speed to Lead: Why Responding in Under 5 Minutes Wins More Customers](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/speed-to-lead-response-time): Most businesses lose leads by replying too slowly. Learn why speed to lead matters, what a good response time is, and how AI follow-up gets you there.
- [The Local SEO Checklist for Home Service Businesses (Roofing, HVAC, Plumbing & More)](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/local-seo-checklist-home-service-businesses): A step-by-step local SEO checklist for roofers, HVAC, plumbers, electricians and contractors — Google Business Profile, service-area pages, reviews and more.
- [7 AI Automations Every Small Business Should Set Up This Year](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/ai-automations-every-small-business-needs): From instant lead replies to review requests and appointment reminders, these seven AI automations save hours every week and win more customers.
- [Google Ads vs. Meta Ads for Service Businesses: Where Should Your Budget Go?](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/google-ads-vs-meta-ads-for-service-businesses): Google captures existing demand; Meta creates it. Here's how to decide where your ad budget should go, with examples by industry and a simple testing plan.
- [Anatomy of a High-Converting Small Business Website](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/high-converting-small-business-website): What separates a website that generates leads from a digital brochure? A section-by-section breakdown of the pages, copy and tech that convert visitors.
- [How to Get More Google Reviews (Without Being Pushy)](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/how-to-get-more-google-reviews): Reviews drive local rankings and trust. Here's a simple, ethical system for getting more 5-star Google reviews — with timing, scripts and automation.
- [Dental Practice Marketing: A Patient-Acquisition Playbook](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/dental-practice-marketing-playbook): How modern dental practices attract new patients: local SEO, Google Ads for high-value treatments, reviews, recall automation and a website that books.
- [LinkedIn Marketing for B2B Founders: A 30-Day Plan](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/linkedin-marketing-for-b2b-founders): A practical 30-day LinkedIn plan for B2B founders: profile optimization, content pillars, a posting rhythm and outreach that turns attention into meetings.
- [How Coaches Build a Predictable Client Pipeline (Without Posting All Day)](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/how-coaches-build-a-predictable-client-pipeline): Referrals and posting aren't a pipeline. Learn the offer, content, funnel and automation system coaches use to book qualified discovery calls every week.
- [Short-Form Video for Local Businesses: What to Post and How to Make It Work](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/short-form-video-for-local-businesses): Reels, TikToks and Shorts aren't just for influencers. Here are proven video ideas for local businesses, a simple production workflow and how to measure ROI.
- [Branding for Service Businesses: Why Premium Positioning Wins](https://n3xventures.vercel.app/blog/branding-for-service-businesses-premium-positioning): Competing on price is a race to the bottom. Learn how positioning, messaging and visual identity let service businesses charge more and close faster.
